items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: Harry Robichaux, Harry Robichaux used to be the ghetto player.

ctx.x: With Elmer Talbot. They used to have, Cuckoo used to play the clarinet. And the cornet and Albert Glennie was our bass player. That was his job. Harry Robichaux, Harry Robichaux used to be the ghetto player.
Yeah I heard him years ago.
